mapper.insert: INSERT INTO statute_article ( id, law_name, status_name, part_name, subpart_name, chapter_name, section_name, article_no, article_number, path_name, body_text) VALUES ( #{id}, #{lawName}, #{statusName}, #{partName}, #{subpartName}, #{chapterName}, #{sectionName}, #{articleNo}, #{articleNumber}, #{pathName}, #{bodyText}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status_name = VALUES(status_name), part_name = VALUES(part_name), subpart_name = VALUES(subpart_name), chapter_name = VALUES(chapter_name), section_name = VALUES(section_name), article_number = VALUES(article_number), path_name = VALUES(path_name), body_text = VALUES(body_text)
mapper.select: SELECT id, law_name AS lawName, status_name AS statusName, part_name AS partName, subpart_name AS subpartName, chapter_name AS chapterName, section_name AS sectionName, article_no AS articleNo, article_number AS articleNumber, path_name AS pathName, body_text AS bodyText FROM statute_article WHERE status_name = '有效' AND (law_name = #{lawName} OR law_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{lawName}, '%')) AND (article_no = #{articleNo} OR article_number = #{articleNumber}) ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(law_name) LIMIT 1

SELECT id, law_name AS lawName, status_name AS statusName, part_name AS partName, subpart_name AS subpartName, chapter_name AS chapterName, section_name AS sectionName, article_no AS articleNo, article_number AS articleNumber, path_name AS pathName, body_text AS bodyText FROM statute_article WHERE status_name = '有效' AND (law_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR article_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR body_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY law_name, article_number LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, law_name AS lawName, status_name AS statusName, part_name AS partName, subpart_name AS subpartName, chapter_name AS chapterName, section_name AS sectionName, article_no AS articleNo, article_number AS articleNumber, path_name AS pathName, body_text AS bodyText FROM statute_article WHERE status_name = '有效' AND id IN #{id}
